description: This Java class 'RateLimitsTriggerProcessor' implements notification trigger processing logic for rate limit events within the Thingsboard platform. It defines methods for matching triggers, constructing notification info, and specifying trigger type.

classes.name: RateLimitsTriggerProcessor
classes.description: Implements processing logic for rate limit notification triggers, including filtering, notification info construction, and trigger type identification.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks if the given trigger matches the specified trigger configuration based on limit level and API label.

methods.name: constructNotificationInfo
methods.description: Builds notification information object based on the trigger details, including tenant and limit level entity names.

methods.name: getTriggerType
methods.description: Returns the trigger type associated with rate limits.
